def create_model_node(config: dict[str, t.Any]) -> ModelNode:
    """Create a ModelNode with the given config."""
    # Known ModelConfig fields
    known_fields = {
        "materialized",
        "on_schema_change",
        "pre_hook",
        "post_hook",
        "meta",
        "contract",
        "unique_key",
    }
    # Separate known fields from extra fields
    config_fields = {k: v for k, v in config.items() if k in known_fields}
    extra_fields = {k: v for k, v in config.items() if k not in known_fields}

    model_config = ModelConfig(**config_fields, _extra=extra_fields)
    return ModelNode(
        database="test_db",
        schema="test_schema",
        name="test_model",
        resource_type=NodeType.Model,
        package_name="test_package",
        path="models/test_model.sql",
        original_file_path="models/test_model.sql",
        unique_id="model.test_package.test_model",
        fqn=["test_package", "test_model"],
        alias="test_model",
        checksum=FileHash(name="sha256", checksum="abc123"),
        config=model_config,
        relation_name="test_table",
        compiled_code="SELECT * FROM table",
    )


def create_seed_node(
    config: dict[str, t.Any] | None = None,
    checksum: str = "abc123seed",
) -> SeedNode:
    """Create a SeedNode with the given config."""
    config = config or {}
    known_fields = {"materialized", "delimiter", "quote_columns", "column_types", "meta"}
    config_fields = {k: v for k, v in config.items() if k in known_fields}
    extra_fields = {k: v for k, v in config.items() if k not in known_fields}

    seed_config = SeedConfig(**config_fields, _extra=extra_fields)
    return SeedNode(
        database="test_db",
        schema="test_schema",
        name="test_seed",
        resource_type=NodeType.Seed,
        package_name="test_package",
        path="seeds/test_seed.csv",
        original_file_path="seeds/test_seed.csv",
        unique_id="seed.test_package.test_seed",
        fqn=["test_package", "test_seed"],
        alias="test_seed",
        checksum=FileHash(name="sha256", checksum=checksum),
        config=seed_config,
        relation_name='"test_db"."test_schema"."test_seed"',
    )


def create_source_definition(
    name: str,
    loaded_at_field: str | None = None,
    loaded_at_query: str | None = None,
    freshness: FreshnessThreshold | None = None,
) -> SourceDefinition:
    unique_id = f"source.test_package.raw_data.{name}"

    kwargs = dict(
        database="test_db",
        schema="raw_data",
        name=name,
        resource_type=NodeType.Source,
        package_name="test_package",
        path="models/sources.yml",
        original_file_path="models/sources.yml",
        unique_id=unique_id,
        fqn=["test_package", "raw_data", name],
        source_name="raw_data",
        source_description="",
        loader="",
        identifier=name,
        loaded_at_field=loaded_at_field,
        freshness=freshness,
    )

    if SUPPORTS_LOADED_AT_QUERY:
        # only present in dbt 1.10+
        kwargs["loaded_at_query"] = loaded_at_query

    return SourceDefinition(**kwargs)

def test_on_execute_sqlglot_error_warns_and_returns_none(

    mocker.patch(
        "dbt_state.run_cache.isinstance",
        side_effect=lambda obj, cls: True
        if cls == (ModelNode, SnapshotNode)
        else _isinstance(obj, cls),
    )

    mock_warn.assert_called_once_with(

        "test_model",
        "Invalid SQL syntax",
    )
    assert result is None

def test_on_execute_emits_enriched_sql_prepared_telemetry_on_success(
    run_cache: RunCache, query_cache_client: Mock, mocker: MockerFixture
) -> None:
    """Test that client overhead telemetry is emitted on successful enriched SQL preparation."""
    perf_counter_values = iter([100.0, 101.0, 102.0, 103.0, 104.0, 105.0])
    mocker.patch("dbt_state.run_cache.perf_counter", side_effect=lambda: next(perf_counter_values))

    node = create_model_node({"materialized": "table"})

    mock_traversal = mocker.Mock()
    mock_traversal.seen_tables = {"table1", "table2", "table3"}
    mock_traversal.view_definitions = {}

    mock_view = mocker.Mock()
    mock_view.definition = "SELECT * FROM table1"
    mock_view.default_catalog = "catalog1"
    mock_view.default_schema = "schema1"

    mock_traversal.view_definitions = {
        "view1": mock_view,
    }

    run_cache._adapter_ext.traverse_view_definitions = mocker.Mock(return_value=mock_traversal)
    run_cache._adapter_ext.get_last_modified_epoch = mocker.Mock(
        return_value={
            "table1": 1234567890,
            "table2": 1234567891,
            "table3": 1234567892,
            "test_table": 9876543210,
        }
    )

    mock_response = sql_service_models.ReadyToExecuteResponse(
        request_id="test_request_id",
        explained_decision=shared_models.ExplainedDecision(
            decision=shared_models.SubmitSQLResultType.READY_TO_EXECUTE,
        ),
    )
    query_cache_client.submit_sql = mocker.Mock(return_value=mock_response)

    run_cache.on_execute(node)

    telemetry_dispatcher = run_cache._telemetry_dispatcher
    telemetry_dispatcher.add_event.assert_called_once()

    call_args = telemetry_dispatcher.add_event.call_args
    event = call_args[0][0]
    assert isinstance(event, client_telemetry_service_models.ClientPrepareEnrichedSQLRequest)

    assert event.request_id is not None
    assert len(event.request_id) > 0
    assert event.duration == 5.0
    assert event.target_table_fqn == "test_table"
    assert event.num_dependencies == 3
    assert event.num_view_dependencies == 1
    assert event.error_type is None
    assert event.view_traversal_duration_ms == 1000
    assert event.last_modified_duration_ms == 1000
    assert event.labels == {
        "dbt_node_name": "test_model",
        "dbt_node_fqn": "test_package.test_model",
        "dbt_node_unique_id": "model.test_package.test_model",
    }

    telemetry_request_id = event.request_id
    submit_sql_call_args = query_cache_client.submit_sql.call_args
    passed_request_id = submit_sql_call_args[0][1]
    submitted_request = submit_sql_call_args[0][0]

    assert telemetry_request_id == passed_request_id
    assert submitted_request.labels == event.labels

def test_on_execute_clone_failure_downgrades_error_and_logs_warning(
    run_cache: RunCache, query_cache_client: Mock, mocker: MockerFixture
) -> None:
    """When clone SQL fails, adapter error events should be downgraded and a warning logged."""
    node = create_model_node({"materialized": "incremental"})

    setup_submit_sql_mocks(run_cache, mocker)
    clone_response = clone_service_models.ReadyToCloneResponse(
        request_id="test_clone_request_id",
        explained_decision=shared_models.ExplainedDecision(
            decision=shared_models.SubmitSQLResultType.READY_TO_CLONE,
        ),
        clone_sqls=["CREATE TABLE dev.test_model CLONE prod.test_model"],
        clone_source="prod.test_model",
        clone_target="dev.test_model",
    )
    query_cache_client.submit_sql = mocker.Mock(return_value=clone_response)

    mock_context = {"config": mocker.Mock()}
    mocker.patch(
        "dbt_state.run_cache.generate_runtime_model_context",
        return_value=mock_context,
    )

    # Simulate adapter.execute firing an error event then raising (as BigQuery does on clone failure)
    def _execute_with_error_event(*args, **kwargs):
        events.fire_error_event("BigQuery adapter error: {}", "Not found: Table prod.test_model")
        raise Exception("Not found: Table prod.test_model")

    run_cache._adapter.execute = mocker.Mock(side_effect=_execute_with_error_event)

    captured_events: t.List[events.EventMsg] = []

    def _capture(msg: events.EventMsg) -> None:
        captured_events.append(msg)

    events.register_callback("test-clone-error", _capture)
    result = run_cache.on_execute(node)

    # Should return NoRunResult with failed_to_clone=True
    assert isinstance(result, NoRunResult)
    assert result.failed_to_clone is True

    # No error-level events should have been emitted
    error_events = [e for e in captured_events if e.info.level == "error"]
    assert error_events == [], f"Unexpected error events: {[e.data.base_msg for e in error_events]}"

    # The adapter error should have been downgraded to debug
    debug_events = [
        e
        for e in captured_events
        if e.info.level == "debug" and "BigQuery adapter error" in e.data.base_msg
    ]
    assert len(debug_events) == 1, (
        f"Expected 1 downgraded debug event, got: {[e.data.base_msg for e in captured_events if e.info.level == 'debug']}"
    )

    # Should have a warning about the clone failure and fallback
    warn_msgs = [
        e.data.base_msg
        for e in captured_events
        if e.info.level == "warn"
        and "clone" in e.data.base_msg.lower()
        and "fail" in e.data.base_msg.lower()
    ]
    assert len(warn_msgs) >= 1, (
        f"Expected warn event about clone failure, got: {[e.data.base_msg for e in captured_events if e.info.level == 'warn']}"
    )

def test_on_execute_skip_response_emits_reused_status_when_enabled(
    run_cache: RunCache, query_cache_client: Mock, mocker: MockerFixture
) -> None:
    """Flag on + dbt build with RunStatus.Reused: emit the new status with no NO-OP prefix."""
    run_cache._run_cache_config.emit_reused_status = True
    # Stand in for RunStatus.Reused on dbt builds that pre-date dbt-labs/dbt-core#12912.
    # Using RunStatus.NoOp keeps the patched value a valid StrEnum member without
    # depending on a specific dbt-core version in the test environment.
    reused_sentinel = RunStatus.Skipped
    mocker.patch("dbt_state.run_cache._RUN_STATUS_REUSED", reused_sentinel)

    node = create_model_node({"materialized": "table"})
    setup_submit_sql_mocks(run_cache, mocker)

    skip_response = sql_service_models.SkipExecutionResponse(

    assert isinstance(result, RunResult)
    assert result.status == reused_sentinel
    # Within-tolerance skip emits a Fusion-style message naming the tolerance.
    assert result.message == "New changes detected within freshness tolerance of 45 minutes"

    # Exact-freshness skip → "No new changes".
    skip_response_fresh = sql_service_models.SkipExecutionResponse(
        explained_decision=shared_models.ExplainedDecision(

    assert result_fresh.message == "No new changes"
